name: Left 4 Bots 2
description:
This is a complete rework of Left 4 Bots (v1). It has pretty much the same functionalities of the V1 but they have been improved, plus some new functionalities have been added.

Please note: the goal of Left 4 Bots has always been to make the survivor bots more human-like, not to turn them into super zombie killing machines.

The addon gives them some functions that the vanilla AI was missing, like defib dead players, scavenge gascans, deadstop special intefected etc, so their combat skills are also improved but they can also fail and fu** things up, sometimes. But isn't this part of the human behavior? :D


What changed?
Almost everything.
The bots are more active while executing the orders, they can attack and shove infected and scavenge items.
The lead order has been completely reworked and it will work on most maps, including finales.
Now you can order each bot to follow another survivor or to go and hold a certain position.
Bots have weapon preferences you can change.
Bots can complete all the official campaigns on their own, look HERE (in The Last Stand campaign you also need this: NavFixes).
And more.
The commands changed too. Look HERE and HERE.

For more details, please check the videos i made about L4B2 on my Youtube Channel.


What didn't change?
The fact that L4B doesn't replace the vanilla AI, it simply adds some features to it.
L4B can make the bots execute your commands, throw nades, defib dead players and do some other stuff that the vanilla AI can't do (not always successfully though) but for most of the time it's still the vanilla AI controlling the bots, with all its known defects.


Addon customization
This addon is fully customizable.
Read HERE.


Useful links

    ADDON COMMANDS
    GITHUB REPOSITORY
    VIDEO TUTORIALS
    L4B1 STYLE CONFIG
    NAVFIXES
    AUTOMATION SCRIPTS FOR CUSTOM CAMPAIGNS



Latest version of the mod
can be found here:

    STABLE VERSION
    DEV VERSION
author: smilzo

name: Left 4 Lib
description:
This addon contains some shared VScript code that is used by my addons:

    Left 4 Bots
    Left 4 Fun
    Left 4 Grief


This addon is mandatory if you have one of the addons listed above. They will not work without this!


Centralized User System
L4L also contains a centralized user system that is shared among all my addons.
The system automatically assigns a user level to the joining player. The other addons will use this level to give/restrict access to certain features to that player.

The L4U user levels are:

    Admin
    Friend
    User
    Griefer

When you first host a local game with this and one of my other addons (Left 4 Fun, Left 4 Bots, Left 4 Lib), you (the host) are automatically added as admin and you will be admin on all the addons.

You can add other admins by editing the file 'ems/left4lib/cfg/admins.txt' or directly ingame with the following commands:

    Via chat: !l4u add [player/character name] admin
    Via console: scripted_user_func l4u,add,[player/character name],admin

Remove the admin with:

    Via chat: !l4u remove [player/character name]
    Via console: scripted_user_func l4u,remove,[player/character name]

At the same way you can assign a Friend or Griefer level to a player:

    Via chat: !l4u add [player/character name] [friend/griefer]
    Via console: scripted_user_func l4u,add,[player/character name],[friend/griefer]

And you can remove the assigned level the same way you remove admins.

The Friend and Griefer lists are saved into the files 'ems/left4lib/cfg/friends.txt' and 'ems/left4lib/cfg/griefers.txt'.
The players who do not belong to any of these lists are automatically given the normal User level.


Addon settings

L4L also has its own settings. You can find more details HERE.

Some of these settings (like hooks_chatcommand_trigger) affect all the addons that use this library.

You can change the settings by editing the file 'ems/left4lib/cfg/settings.txt'.


Compatibility

This should be fully compatible with any Admin System/VSLib version and most addons in general.


Are you a L4D2 modder?

You are free to use the features contained in this addon, if you want to. Technical details can be found in the form of comments inside the .nut files.
Only one thing i ask you: please, do not put the L4L files in your addon but consider referencing L4L as an external required addon like i do in L4F, L4B and L4G. Reason for this is that by duplicating this library you will create multiple versions of it making the addons using the library incompatible with each other.

More info can be found on the L4L GitHub Repository.


Like my mods?
Donations are not required but are greatly appreciated.

author: smilzo

name: Left 4 Fun
description:
You want to change something in the game like increasing/decreasing the number of infected or you want to be able to crawl when you are incapped?
You want to increase the melee range and actually hit someone when you swing your axe or you want to jump high with lower gravity?

Modding system
This addon allows you to define different "variations" (mods) of the normal gameplay and switch to any of them whenever you want with a simple chat command.
It's like making your own mutations but without the need to know how to make mutations and, unlike the real mutations, it doesn't create it's own game mode, it mods the existing game modes. So you can mod the normal coop, survival, versus and the other base game modes and even the existing mutations.
All you have to do is create a text file with all the CVAR changes you want to make, then type:
[code]
!l4f settings mod yourmodname
[/code]
Done. From now on, whenever you host a game, the mod will be automatically loaded.
You can switch to another mod whenever you want with the same command or you can go back to vanilla with:
[code]
!l4f settings mod none
[/code]
The game CVARS you can change can be found HERE.

The addon also has its own "extra" CVARS you can add to your mod text file. These extra CVARS (you can find HERE) add new functionalities, like auto revive/respawn, buy system with money pickups, double jump, zombie drops, and lots more.

More details on how to make your L4F mods can be found HERE.
You can even try the sample mods i already made. You can find them HERE.
You can play them but you can also open the addon's .VPK file with GCFScape, see how they are made and modify them.


Bug fixes and QoL improvements
L4F also fixes a few game bugs and adds some "Quality of Life" improvements, like:

    When you start reloading your weapon, the previous bullets aren't removed until the reload animation is finished. This means that if the reload is interrupted, you aren't left with 0 bullets in your weapon.
    You don't automatically drop your M60 when it's empty.
    Survivors who join/leave the game during the escape sequence of a campaign are no longer reported as DEAD in the credit screen. And more.



Admin commands
The addon comes with its own admin commands (kick, ban, spawn things, fun commands and many other commands you can find HERE).
But it's also 100% compatible with Admin System.

Left 4 Fun shares the same admins file with all my other addons, so a Left 4 Fun admin is also admin on Left 4 Bots and Left 4 Grief.


How to install
[olist]
    Subscribe
    Subscribe to Left 4 Lib
    Done
[/olist]
For dedicated servers simply upload the .vpk files into the server's "Left 4 Dead 2/left4dead2/addons" directory.


How to add admins
This addon uses the "Left 4 Lib" centralized user system. Refer to the Left 4 Lib addon page to see how to add/remove admins/friends/griefers.


Addon settings
The list of L4F settings can be found HERE.

You can change the settings by editing the file 'ems/left4fun/cfg/host_settings.txt' or directly ingame with the following commands:

    Via chat: !l4f settings [setting] [value]
    Via console: scripted_user_func l4f,settings,[setting],[value]



Compatibility
This addon is 100% compatible with my other addons Left 4 Bots and Left 4 Grief.
It should also be compatible with most of the addons of the workshop.


Useful links

    Addon Commands
    Addon Settings
    Visual Menu for L4F
    L4F Sample Mods


More info can be found on the L4F GitHub Repository.


Like my mods?
Donations are not required but are greatly appreciated.

name: Admin System
description:
With the Admin System, you are given Admin control. You can spawn Infected, give Survivors weapons/items, kill/revive Survivors, change Convars, change the timescale, and much, much more!

All of this is done server-side via chat triggers. If you don't have a server, all you need to do is host a Local Server and you should automatically be added as an Admin. If you want to give other players Admin control, you can type "!add_admin nick" if they're playing as Nick, or "!add_admin <playername>" to add their Steam ID to the admins.txt file.

If you have a server, you'll need to manually upload an admins.txt file to your left4dead2/ems/admin system folder. If one doesn't exist, create one.

Click here for a complete list of available commands.

Check out Admin System Radial Controller created by jyrka98, for use with the Admin System.

name: ion's Vocalizer
description:
The most complete L4D2 vocalizer with nearly 800 vocalization lines. The real deal.


FEATURES


13 radial menus with shared voice lines
9 radial menus with character-specific voice lines (for each character)
Radial menu for character selection/switching and going idle
Setting up keys for the radial menus is easy through game's options
Works online on official, dedicated and local servers, and in single player
Full compatibility with The Last Stand and newer updates
Powered by VScript talker – no conflicts with other talkers



Extra features available when installed on hosting server:

Rare and unused voice lines for all characters (limited use)
All of Ellis and Keith stories (limited use)
Coughing, breathing, singing and various screams (limited use)
Non-Playable Characters vocalizations (limited use)
Vocalizations when playing as Special Infected (limited use)
Some of default shared voice lines have additional responses (limited use)
All voice lines can be used immediately in safe rooms (limited use)
Infected callouts are available even after rescue vehicle has arrived (limited use)
Laugh, Taunt and Scream are available in Versus (limited use)
...and much, much more (see Change Notes for full details)




INSTALLATION

[olist]
Subscribe, start Left 4 Dead 2 and wait for add-ons to load.

Go to Add-ons menu and disable any conflicting add-ons.
(e.g. other vocalizer or add-ons with radial menus)

Go to Options menu and bind the radial menus to the keys you want.
Options → Keyboard/Mouse → Edit Keys/Buttons → Vocalizer Radial Menus
[/olist]



SUGGESTED KEYS

[code]
F4  —  Character selection

 Z  —  Orders
 X  —  Questions and answers
 C  —  Reactions
 V  —  Enemies
 B  —  Warnings
 N  —  Events
 G  —  Miscellaneous 1
 H  —  Miscellaneous 2
 I  —  Miscellaneous 3
 J  —  Character-specific 1
 M  —  Character-specific 2
 K  —  Character-specific 3
 ,  —  Character-specific 4
 L  —  Character-specific 5
 .  —  Character-specific 6
 ;  —  Character-specific 7
 /  —  Character-specific 8 (limited use)
 '  —  Character-specific 9 (limited use)
 O  —  Miscellaneous 4 (limited use)
 P  —  Miscellaneous 5 (limited use)
 [  —  Miscellaneous 6 (limited use)
 ]  —  NPCs (limited use)
[/code]



HOW TO USE


Character-specific menus
Press and hold the key for Character selection menu and choose your current character. After that, you'll be able to use its character-specific menus.

Voice lines
Press and hold key for a desired menu, then choose a voice line. All other players will hear what your character is saying.

Going idle
Press and hold the key for Character selection menu and choose IDLE.

Character switching
First go idle. Then using Character selection menu choose another available character.




IMPORTANT TO KNOW

[quote]
What is "limited use"
These voice lines will work only on local servers and dedicated servers where this add-on is installed, and in single player. They CANNOT WORK on official Valve servers!

Miscellaneous menus
Some voice lines in these menus work only for L4D1 and some only for L4D2 characters.

Some voice lines can't always work
For some lines to work, certain conditions have to be met (for example, you must not be in fight). Also, many voice lines are not available in Scavenge and Survival.

When can't go idle
You can't go idle if you are the only player, or if all other players are already idle.

Note on switching characters
After switching characters, you will need to select your new character again to properly mount all of its character-specific menus.

Vocalizer in Versus and Scavenge on official servers
All add-ons are disabled when playing competitive modes on official Valve servers. However, you can follow my guide to make the vocalizer work there.
[/quote]



DEDICATED SERVER INSTALLATION
(for server admins only)

Install the add-on on your server, so players can use all radial menus and all responses:
[olist]
Download my vocalizer from GameMaps
Put the VPK file in \left4dead2\addons
Restart your server
[/olist]


CREDITS


Add-on is derived from earlier version of VOX vocalizer
Add-on thumbnail image is made by StoneRabbit



NOTICE FOR MODDERS

[quote]
You can use my vocalizer (in whole or part of it) as a foundation for your own mod. But if you release that mod anywhere, you're required to give me proper credit — write in your mod's description that it's based on ion's Vocalizer (with link to this page).
[/quote]
author: ion

name: NavFixes
description:
More bot friendly nav meshes.

Contains a few changes to the nav meshes of

  The Last Stand chapter 1 (to let the bots press the crane button and not get stuck at the truck)
  The Parish chapter 4 (bots no longer get stuck trying to jump between the two balconies)
  Dead Center chapter 2 (bots can get the van shortcut while delivering the cola bottles)
  The Parish chapter 5 (bots can get the fence shortcut at the end of the map)


Is this mandatory with Left 4 Bots 2?
Only if you want to use the automation feature on The Last Stand chapter 1 because the vanilla navmesh doesn't let the bots jump on the crane to press the button.
The others are just optional improvements.
